comparison.objective: Diagnose a faulty cable core with a hand-crank tester, versus tune damping from carriage behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Probe placement plus simultaneous cranking and fault marking differ from recessed tool engagement, collar tuning, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: All cores tested under crank-speed/contact criteria and only the failed core flagged versus two acceptable impacts and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both include iterative physical testing, but one tests electrical fault identification and the other mechanical parameter commissioning.
